messages:
IncidentBot: ALERT: paging gateway failed to deliver to current on-call for service `inference-router` (webhook timeout from Pager gateway). auto-escalation suppressed.

pagerduty: webhook delivery error: 502 Bad Gateway -> repeatedly failing to ACK. see logs below.

Mia: seeing 5xx responses from the paging proxy, looks like our outbound gateway is timing out to pager service. not seeing auto pages for the last 7 incidents.

Devon: thanks — i'm oncall. can someone confirm if this is a config flip or network? I don't see any infra deploys in the last hour.

Jules: customer reports they didn't get a page for an ongoing latency spike. ticket #INC-4521. they called support directly. no PD alert landed.

Asha: cc @Mia @Devon this caused an SLO miss for the customer (webhooks queued but not delivered). we need quick mitigation and an update for status page.

Mia: quick triage logs from the gateway:
```
2026-03-15T19:11:02Z outbound_gateway request id=abc123 -> POST https://pager.example/api/events 502 timeout
2026-03-15T19:11:03Z outbound_gateway queue length=312
2026-03-15T19:11:07Z outbound_gateway retry=1 id=abc123 -> 200 OK
2026-03-15T19:12:30Z outbound_gateway circuit=open backend=pgw-eu-1
```
Looks like the gateway started to retry and then opened a circuit breaker. backend metrics show high latency 1s->9s.

Devon: i'm going to flip routing to the fallback pager gateway (pgw-us-fallback) and kick manual pages for critical incidents. Mia please confirm the fallback has keys configured.

Mia: confirmed fallback has valid creds but not enabled in the routing policy. enabling now. running `/infractl routing set pager-gateway fallback=true --service=inference-router`

Ops Bot: Command accepted. routing policy updated. new outbound gateway: pgw-us-fallback.

Devon: manually paged on-call (sms+call) for the active customer incident. please ack in thread when you get notified.

Jules: we got manual confirmation — customer oncall got an SMS at +1-415-555-0199. they joined the bridge.

Mia: pushing a short-term mitigation: reduce outbound concurrency and increase retry interval to avoid tripping circuit. applying config:
```json
{"outbound_concurrency": 4, "retry_interval_ms": 2500}
```
Applying now.

IncidentBot: system note: automation that handles handoffs detected inconsistency and suppressed handoff to next rotation to avoid double-paging. That suppression prevented failover automation from triggering.

Devon: oof — so two problems: 1) backend latency opened circuit, 2) automation suppressed handoff because last event looked
